_meta.purpose: Experimental Tm benchmark to validate the tool's nearest-neighbour Tm model INDEPENDENTLY, using real measured duplex Tm from two independent Owczarzy datasets (34 oligos total: 18 magnesium-series + 16 sodium-series).

dataset_source.mg_series: Owczarzy R, Moreira BG, You Y, Behlke MA, Walder JA. Biochemistry 2008;47(19):5336-5353. DOI 10.1021/bi702363u. PMID 18422348. Data = Table 1 (18 DNA duplexes, Tm at 9 Mg2+ concentrations). tm_experimental_c = 1.5 mM Mg2+ column (matches tool P3_DEFAULT_DV_CONC); full 9-col array in tm_by_mg_mM (mg_columns_mM).
dataset_source.na_series: Owczarzy R, You Y, Moreira BG, Manthey JA, Huang L, Behlke MA, Walder JA. Biochemistry 2004;43(12):3537-3554. DOI 10.1021/bi034621r. PMID 15035624. Data = Table 2 (subset of 16 of 92 duplexes spanning length 10-25 nt and GC 20-80%). tm_experimental_c = 69 mM Na+ column (lowest, closest to tool default 50 mM); full 5-col array in tm_by_na_mM (na_columns_mM). Mg2+ = 0 for this series.

_meta.transcription_note: Both series parsed from the article PDFs (2008 Table 1, 2004 Table 2) via text extraction on 2026-07-03, then independently RE-PARSED for cross-check: all Mg rows and 4 spot-checked Na rows matched exactly; f(GC) column agreed with computed GC for every Na row. Values are physically consistent (monotonic in salt, sensible ranges). Ct = 2 uM total strand for both. Still RECOMMENDED to eyeball-verify against the PDFs before publication.

measurement_conditions.buffer: 2 mM Tris-HCl for [Mg2+] 0.5-20 mM; 10 mM Tris-HCl for [Mg2+] 50-600 mM. No KCl, no added NaCl.
measurement_conditions.monovalent_from_tris_mM: ~1 mM for 2 mM Tris (half protonated); ~5 mM for 10 mM Tris.
measurement_conditions.CRITICAL_concentration_convention: Ct = TOTAL single-strand concentration = 2 uM. The SantaLucia non-self-complementary Tm formula uses CT/4 inside the ln(). primer3.calc_tm() divides dna_conc by 4 INTERNALLY — pass Ct (2000 nM) directly; do NOT pre-divide. Confirmed experimentally: passing Ct=2000 gives MAE~2-3 C vs exp; passing Ct/4=500 gives ~4-5 C systematic under-prediction.
measurement_conditions.CRITICAL_predict_at_measured_conditions: Predict Tm at THIS dataset's conditions (Mg2+ per column, monovalent ~1 mM, Ct=2000 nM), NOT the tool's default (Na+ 50 mM). Otherwise the comparison is invalid.

honesty_rules: Only entries with verified==true enter MAE/bias.
tm_experimental_c below = the 1.5 mM Mg2+ column for Mg-series (matches tool P3_DEFAULT_DV_CONC=1.5) and 69 mM Na+ column for Na-series.
Do NOT invent values. These were transcribed from the source PDF tables.
CRITICAL_do_not_confuse: This is OLIGO/PRIMER DUPLEX Tm (what the tool predicts), NOT amplicon melting-curve (product) Tm.
Do NOT validate the SantaLucia-1998 model using the SantaLucia 1998 dataset (circular). Owczarzy 2008 is independent.

tool_salt_conditions.note: These are the tool's DEFAULT operating conditions (constants.py). They are NOT the measurement conditions of this benchmark; see measurement_conditions above.

known_bias_2026-07-03.interpretation: Tool (primer3 SantaLucia NN) systematically UNDER-predicts Tm by ~2-3 C across both Na and Mg series. Bias is larger for Mg series (short oligos 10-11 nt are 4-5 C off). This is consistent with known limitations of SantaLucia 1998 NN at low salt and short oligo length. The tool's actual operating range (primers 15-25 nt, 50 mM Na + 1.5 mM Mg + 0.8 mM dNTP) may behave differently from these benchmark conditions (1 mM Na for Mg-series, 69 mM Na for Na-series, no dNTP). Do NOT adjust TM_FORWARD_TARGET blindly.
known_bias_2026-07-03.action: Monitor, do not change TM_FORWARD_TARGET yet. The bias at ACTUAL operating conditions (50 mM Na + 1.5 mM Mg + 0.8 mM dNTP, primers 15-25 nt) is unknown. Collect in-lab Tm measurements at those conditions for directly relevant calibration.

mg_series_divalent_conversion.source: von Ahsen N et al. Clin Chem 2001;47(11):1956-1961. DOI 10.1093/clinchem/47.11.1956
mg_series_divalent_conversion.confirmed_from: primer3 C source: oligotm.c divalent_to_monovalent() lines 774-784; santalucia branch lines 447-449
mg_series_divalent_conversion.independence_note: von Ahsen 2001 uses its own experimental dataset, published 7 years before Owczarzy 2008. Neither the formula nor the dataset overlaps with Owczarzy 2008. Mg2+ series is fully independent.

circularity_verdict.na_series: NONE — SantaLucia entropy correction applied to K_mM (Na+) directly. Owczarzy 2004 Na+ data is fully independent of SantaLucia 1998.
circularity_verdict.mg_series: NONE — pipeline uses von Ahsen 2001 divalent conversion (not Owczarzy) then SantaLucia entropy. Owczarzy 2008 Mg2+ data is independent from both steps.
circularity_verdict.paper_wording_na: independent validation of the SantaLucia 1998 monovalent salt correction
circularity_verdict.paper_wording_mg: independent validation of the full divalent pipeline: von Ahsen 2001 divalent-to-monovalent conversion [DOI 10.1093/clinchem/47.11.1956] followed by SantaLucia 1998 entropy correction

salt_correction_independence_2026-07-03.owczarzy_comparison: Empirical test on 34 oligos: santalucia MAE=2.68 C Bias=-2.65 C; owczarzy MAE=2.64 C Bias=-2.08 C. Owczarzy marginally better but would create partial circularity with Owczarzy 2008 data. Keep santalucia.
salt_correction_independence_2026-07-03.label_fix: thermodynamics.py header previously said 'Owczarzy 2004 Mg2+ correction' — WRONG on both method name (SantaLucia) and year (2004 is Na+; 2008 is Mg2+). Fixed 2026-07-03.
salt_correction_independence_2026-07-03.dna_rna_gap: primer3.calc_tm uses DNA:DNA NN params. RT primer hybridizes with miRNA (RNA) -> DNA:RNA hybrid. Sugimoto 1995 params needed for exact RT primer Tm; current Tm is an approximation valid for relative comparison only. RT primers excluded from check_tm.py validation (primer_type='rt' filter).
